provenance.tree_type: 236-QC-locus Comp1061 compatibility ML phylogram, substitutions/site, not dated
provenance.source_taxonomy: Japan38 concept/tip map, NMNS botanical authority seed and extension

estimand: Spearman correlation between nuclear patristic distances and discrete 0/1 trait-state mismatches across nonindependent taxon pairs
valid_inference: Within one pinned Japanese Cirsium nuclear topology, source-coded extant trait descriptions only

synthesis.relationship_to_EAzami_previous_asr: Multiple minimum state changes (orientation6, phyllary3, sticky5) are compatible with weak marginal trait-distance correlation; parsimony event count and patristic signal are different estimands.
uncertainty: These 19/13/6 authority-state cohorts are not random draws of all Japan38 species and source descriptions are heterogeneous.
Only one 2026 reconstructed ML compatibility topology with substitution-unit branch lengths; 1000-bootstrap topology uncertainty not evaluated for this new rho.
An exact label permutation null is conditional on this tree and observed label counts; its p does not prove a biological absence of history.
Different taxa are scored across modules, so rho contrasts are not causal comparisons of evolutionary constraint strengths.
No matching aligned multi-locus phylogeny for all 11 independent East Asian candidate taxa; cross-lineage portability remains unidentified.
The sources do not measure within-population heritability, real head-gravity angles per biological plant, pollinator activity, or DNA reexpression.
synthesis.next_stage: Use source-backed alternative topology/phylogenomic trees and external lineage held-out trait+DNA tip matching before estimating memory portability; leave Q2 physical guild function and Q3 heritable floral reexpression as independent experiments.
